items.a: Nine professional categories: 1) Beauty & Grooming (threading, all wax types), 2) Facial Treatments (clean-up, fundamental, advanced, HydraFacial), 3) Hand & Foot Care, 4) Wellness & Massage, 5) Hair Care, 6) Hair Cutting & Styling, 7) Salon Management, 8) Basic Makeup Technician, 9) Advanced Hair Treatments (smoothening + hair botox).

Hands-on, founder-led training at our Hubli or Belagavi centres. Each day combines focused theory with extensive supervised practice — including live demonstrations by Priyanka Sakhe and salon-floor technique drills. You leave with both knowledge and muscle memory.

Graduates receive the Master Beauty Academy Professional Beautician Certificate, signed by the founders. Because the curriculum spans skincare, hair, wellness and makeup, the certificate makes you employable across the full salon-floor — not just one specialty.

items.q: Does the course teach makeup as well?
items.a: Yes. Category 8 is a Basic Makeup Technician programme — product knowledge, face preparation and everyday makeup application — taught personally by Priyanka Sakhe (LAPT London, Global Fame Awards 2023). Advanced bridal makeup is offered as a specialisation post-graduation.

items.q: Can I open my own salon after this course?
items.a: Yes. Category 7 specifically covers Salon Management Training — customer handling, basic salon operations, beauty parlour management and professional grooming standards. Over 1,000 of our graduates now run independent salons, many earning up to ₹1 lakh per month.
₹40,000 — a single, flat, all-inclusive fee. There are no separate charges for kit, materials, certification or assessment. Interest-free EMI plans across 2 or 3 months are available.
